text:
Alex Tuch's first season in Washington comes with noise from his last stop: Yahoo Sports reports the Sabres' general manager has pushed back on Tuch's account of how he left Buffalo. On the ice there's nothing messy about it. Tuch scored again Saturday in a 4-3 win over Florida that the Capitals finished without Tom Wilson, ejected for boarding Sandis Vilmanis, and Tuch played 24 minutes, his most in ten games.

That's 11 goals in 15 games, none on the power play, and by our win model his goals have added more wins than all but seven skaters in the league. Part of it is real: he's getting 1.62 expected goals per 60 on his own shots (the quality of his looks), up from 0.91 last season. Part of it isn't: 26% shooting won't hold. The twist is that his teammates have scored 4.8 fewer goals than their chances with him on the ice, so his assists should pick up as his goals slow. Our projection for the rest of the season starts at 31 more goals.
headline: Tuch keeps scoring while Buffalo argues
